name: sheffield-museums

subject.name: Sheffield Museums
subject.audience: visitors of all ages to six Sheffield venues
subject.primaryJob: tell remarkable stories of Sheffield and its people, and show which venue is speaking
sources: Stephenson Blake & Co's Sheffield foundry, behind Caslon Doric (S30)

principles: a working sans-serif with a Sheffield foundry history (S30)
plain signage lettering, tall and legible (S16, S19)

territories.name: The working museum
territories.description: Galleries and workshops: flat fields of venue color, a big plain title, a seal in the corner, and the object or artwork given the room.

muse.name: the Stephenson Blake foundry, Sheffield
muse.take: type that is local and made to work (S30)

signature.concept: square color fields and one round seal
signature.reason: S20 butts venue fields edge to edge; on the museum territory every corner stays square, so the seal is the only circle a visitor sees

avoid: more than two palette colors together, black and grey aside (S26)

rationale.grounding.primary: Inferred from S30's history. Departs from the canon's natural vibrancy: the venue heroes are saturated (S26).
rationale.color.anchors.0: S26, printed HEX. The dark green of the cover and chapter pages (S01, S25), which is also Shepherd Wheel's hero.
rationale.color.anchors.3: S26 venue hero, printed HEX. Data roles hold the heroes because the schema has no per-venue color.
rationale.color.character.vibrancy: Departs from the archive canon's muted: S26's heroes are saturated and run full-bleed
rationale.color.character.neutral: the common grey is slightly green (S26)
rationale.type.faces: Stand-in. Caslon Doric (S30) is outside the catalogue; Libre Franklin is the closest grotesque. Arial is the book's fallback (S31); Helvetica Neue is the nearest catalogue face.
rationale.type.character.type-scale: large titles over small text (S29), which classic matches; dramatic doubled it
rationale.form.curvature: square fields, cards and posters; the seal is the only circle (S20, S26)
rationale.adaptivity: mostly white pages with green chapter fields (S04, S25, S26)
rationale.type.weights: Semibold is the book's heaviest weight (S30)
rationale.color.character.solid-depth: One step deeper solids so text on the primary clears contrast in both schemes; the exact brand color stays pinned.
